task: put the wine bottle on top of the cabinet

windows.text: Reach the open gripper horizontally toward the wine bottle standing on the table.
Approach the wine bottle from above, lowering the open gripper toward its neck.
Approach the wine bottle from above, lowering the open gripper around its neck.
Approach the wine bottle from above, lowering the open gripper around its neck.
Grasp the wine bottle by closing the gripper fingers around its neck while it stands on the table.
Lift the wine bottle up off the table, raising it above the metal bowl.
Lift the wine bottle up off the table, moving it toward the cabinet.
Lift the wine bottle up off the table, moving it toward the cabinet.
Lift the wine bottle up off the table, raising it above the cabinet.
Lower the wine bottle down onto the top surface of the cabinet.
Release the wine bottle onto the top of the cabinet.
Hold the open gripper stationary above the wine bottle resting on the cabinet.
